description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (Fusoya)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (Fusoya)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Holy abilities after using 1/2/3+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Regenga], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode II (Fusoya)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (Fusoya)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Highborn Mode II (Fusoya)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [HP Stock (1000)]/[HP Stock (2000)]/[HP Stock (3000)] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ Holy attacks

description.name: HP Stock (1000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 1000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: HP Stock (2000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 2000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
